title: RegenManifest
description: M4A § per-pipeline regen scripts + model_version pin. Stored at content/asset_ledger/regen_manifest.ron. Each pipeline declares the canonical regen command + pinned model version + determinism notes. M4A locks the schema at v1; new pipelines append new entries without bumping.

regen_command.description: Shell-style command template. May reference $ASSET_ID / $OUTPUT_PATH / $SEED / $PROMPT placeholders.

deterministic.description: When true, the pipeline produces byte-identical output across machines for the same seed. When false, the regenerator uses freeze-then-store.

freeze_path_suffix.description: Suffix used to derive the canonical freeze path. Default '.frozen'.
